It functions as an ultra-secure epicenter for cutting-edge corporate research and state affairs, thoroughly isolated from the gang violence of the Outer City.

Locations.name: The Outskirts Of London
Locations.classification_tags: Slums, Flooded District, Wasteland, Criminal Underworld, Lawless Zone
Locations.lore_description: Known colloquially as Flood Town or Drownsville, this precarious fourth zone of London sits beyond the safety of the main city protections. It serves as a perilous haven for destitute citizens, ruthless scavengers, and underground gangs struggling to survive outside corporate law.
Locations.visual_description_for_image_gen: Partially submerged ruins and ad-hoc shanties cobbled from rusted shipping containers stretch across brackish, rain-swept floodwaters beneath the looming shadow of the massive Sea Wall. Faint, sputtering neon and chemical fires cast sickly reflections on the oily water, while improvised catwalks and rope bridges weave precariously between half-drowned tenement skeletons.
